# layers/cloud/aws/test-load/

Run load and performance tests against staging using k6. Generates a test script if one doesn't exist, runs it, benchmarks p50/p95/p99 latency and error rate, and writes a performance report. Also checks frontend bundle size. Usage — /test-load [run|bundle|baseline] [endpoint-or-script]
